RECOMMENDED GUARDRAILS

    HOW IT WORKSZERO API COST
    A

    Signal extraction

    Normalizes text and measures instruction overrides, secret requests, tool abuse, obfuscation, and role impersonation.

    B

    Rule score

    A transparent weighted heuristic combines matched signals. The number is not an attack probability or a calibrated confidence estimate.

    C

    Handling suggestions

    Produces a suggested plan. This page does not intercept agent tools or enforce access controls.

    Evaluation: 36 development examples and 20 holdout examples: 6/10 attacks detected, 3/10 harmless cases flagged. Read the confusion matrix and misses. Synthetic examples cannot establish real-world security. Keep tool permissions independent of this score.
